"""Export a small, self-contained furniture library, keeping supplied files intact."""
import bpy
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source=ROOT/'model/interier/oldfurniturepack_01_blend/OldFurniturePack_01.blend'
bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=str(source),load_ui=False)
chosen={'WoodenShelf_03':('ArchiveShelf',(1.5,.7,2.8)),'Chair_02':('ArchiveChair',(.85,.85,1.65)),'Carpet_01':('ArchiveRug',(6,4,.018))}
for o in list(bpy.data.objects):
    if o.name not in chosen: bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    name,target=chosen[o.name]
    # Bake the original world transform before fitting, so GLTF uses clean local origins.
    o.data.transform(o.matrix_world);o.matrix_world.identity()
    points=[v.co for v in o.data.vertices]
    low=Vector([min(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
    high=Vector([max(p[i] for p in points) for i in range(3)])
    center=(low+high)*.5
    for v in o.data.vertices:
        v.co=Vector(((v.co.x-center.x)*target[0]/(high.x-low.x),(v.co.y-center.y)*target[1]/(high.y-low.y),(v.co.z-low.z)*target[2]/(high.z-low.z)))
    o.name=name
for image in bpy.data.images:
    if image.source=='FILE':
        image.filepath=bpy.path.abspath(image.filepath)
        if max(image.size)>1024:
            factor=1024/max(image.size);image.scale(max(1,int(image.size[0]*factor)),max(1,int(image.size[1]*factor)))
        image.pack()
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'model/interior-selected.blend'))
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(ROOT/'spider-game/public/models/interior-selected.glb'),export_format='GLB',export_animations=False)
print('EXPORTED',[(o.name,len(o.data.vertices)) for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH'])

# Каракурт: Возмездие — модели и источники

New procedural karakurt components, furniture, books, lamp, slipper, cushion seams and guitar strings: created in Blender for this project. Source: model/karakurt-production.blend; export: karakurt-atelier.glb. Procedural IK attribution: PROCEDURAL-SPIDER-LICENSE.txt.

Remy and animation FBX files: supplied by the user in model/persona (Mixamo-named rig). Original distribution rights have not been independently verified; confirm the source license before public distribution. Runtime export: remy-karakurt.gltf with remy-textures and binary buffer; Blender NLA tracks Idle, Walk, Run, Collision, Fall, plus authored Attack. Sources preserved.

# Supplied interior selection

OldFurniturePack_01 supplied by the user in model/interier/oldfurniturepack_01_blend. Source author and license not yet established; confirm rights before public distribution. Chair_02, WoodenShelf_03 and Carpet_01 were fitted, grounded and exported as interior-selected.glb with embedded textures limited to 1024px. Editable copy: model/interior-selected.blend. Original files preserved. See model/NEW-ASSETS.md for the inspection of other furniture and the supplied animated karakurt candidate.

# Elemental spider — supplied replacement

PBR Jumping Spider Monster — Toast (https://sketchfab.com/eternity8361).
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pbr-jumping-spider-monster-92e54bef46114d4bb7f09dc078612075
License: CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Original files preserved in model/spider/elemental-spider. Copy: elemental-spider.glb.
The supplied original GLB is a static mesh without bones or animation; preserved unchanged. Modified in Blender: normalized mesh, 18-bone skin (body, abdomen, eight two-segment legs) and skin weights. Editable source: model/elemental-rigged.blend; game export: elemental-rigged.glb. Runtime procedural IK uses world-space foot contacts. Rig preview: /elemental-walk.html; original inspection: /spider-preview.html.

# Spider with Animation (preserved original game)

Author: maksroberthut — https://sketchfab.com/maksroberthut
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/spider-with-animation-ba8149ca471a4708bfdba07460450815
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Provided by the user as spider_with_animation_1k_texture.glb.
Changes: materials converted from specular/glossiness to metallic/roughness with glTF Transform. Runtime scale and placement adjusted for the game. Original animation retained. Blender-authored Walk (alternating eight-leg hip sweeps and foot lifts), TurnLeft and TurnRight (opposed leg stepping and hip sweeps) added in model/spider-animations.blend; exported as spider-animated.glb (preserved). Current game asset: spider-walker-ik.glb. Walk was replaced with a Spider Walker 1.0.6 bake through eight 3-bone IK chains, sampled to deform-bone transforms for Three.js. Editable copy and original scene: model/spider-walker-ik.blend. Source models unchanged. Additional Blender-authored Idle (abdomen breathing), Jump (leg tuck / landing compression), and WebCast (abdomen raise / silk contraction pulses) included.

# Новые модели: проверка и подключение

## Подключённая первая подборка

Из `interier/oldfurniturepack_01_blend/OldFurniturePack_01.blend` экспортированы:
- `Chair_02` → `ArchiveChair`: 3088 вершин;
- `WoodenShelf_03` → `ArchiveShelf`: 626 вершин;
- `Carpet_01` → `ArchiveRug`: 1208 вершин.

Копия: `interior-selected.blend`; игровой экспорт: `../spider-game/public/models/interior-selected.glb`. Текстуры упакованы, уменьшены до 1024 пикселей по большей стороне. Исходные файлы не изменяются. Экспорт повторяется через `blender_mcp/export_interior.py` в Blender. Добавлены отдельные коллизии, размещение оставляет проходы и воспоминания свободными.

## Пауки

Набор `spider/spiders_characters_with_animations/Spiders - characters with animations/` содержит каракурта, тарантулов, крестовика, скакунчика и других пауков. Проверенный `karakurt.fbx`: 594 вершины, 610 полигонов, 70 костей; клипы `idle`, `idle_2`, `walk`, `attack_1`, `attack_2`, `dead`. При импорте FBX текстура автоматически не подключилась; рядом есть `Textures/karakurt_difuse.png`. Новый кандидат не заменяет Elemental: требуется адаптация рига к процедурным мировым опорам, проверка направлений лап и состояний прыжка/паутины.

## Другие находки

`interier/blender/Blender/Bed.blend`: основание 20050 вершин, матрас 3234; исходные пути к четырём картам неверны (`../Textures`), реальные файлы находятся в `Blender/Textures`. Пока не подключена.

`bookshelf.blend`, `furniture_02.blend`, `light_pack.blend`, `sm_books.blend` и большой набор `10_78ik45y34` доступны, но пока не прошли полный пообъектный осмотр и визуальную приёмку.

Подробные измерения: `new-assets-inspection.json`. Лицензии новых пользовательских наборов не установлены; перед публичным распространением нужны источники и условия использования.
